```python
import sys, json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def to_float(x):
    return round(float(x), 2)

def to_pct(x):
    return round(float(x), 1)

df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])

facts = []

# ---------- TOTALS ----------
rev_tw = df['Revenue_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
rev_lw = df['Revenue_LW'].sum(skipna=True)
rev_ly = df['Revenue_LY'].sum(skipna=True)
units_tw = df['Units_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
units_lw = df['Units_LW'].sum(skipna=True)
orders_tw = df['Orders_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
orders_lw = df['Orders_LW'].sum(skipna=True)

facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "revenue", "period": "TW",
              "value": to_float(rev_tw), "formula": "sum(Revenue_TW)"})
facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "revenue", "period": "LW",
              "value": to_float(rev_lw), "formula": "sum(Revenue_LW)"})
if df['Revenue_LY'].notna().any():
    facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "revenue", "period": "LY",
                  "value": to_float(rev_ly), "formula": "sum(Revenue_LY)"})

facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "units", "period": "TW",
              "value": to_float(units_tw), "formula": "sum(Units_TW)"})
facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "units", "period": "LW",
              "value": to_float(units_lw), "formula": "sum(Units_LW)"})
facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "orders", "period": "TW",
              "value": to_float(orders_tw), "formula": "sum(Orders_TW)"})
facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "orders", "period": "LW",
              "value": to_float(orders_lw), "formula": "sum(Orders_LW)"})

if rev_lw and not np.isnan(rev_lw) and rev_lw != 0:
    wow_total = (rev_tw - rev_lw) / rev_lw * 100
    facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "revenue", "period": "WoW",
                  "value": to_pct(wow_total),
                  "formula": "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100"})

if rev_ly and not np.isnan(rev_ly) and rev_ly != 0:
    yoy_total = (rev_tw - rev_ly) / rev_ly * 100
    facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "revenue", "period": "YoY",
                  "value": to_pct(yoy_total),
                  "formula": "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100"})

# ---------- TOP ENTITIES BY REVENUE_TW ----------
top_df = df.dropna(subset=['Revenue_TW']).sort_values('Revenue_TW', ascending=False)
top_n = top_df.head(3)

for _, row in top_n.iterrows():
    facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric": "revenue", "period": "TW",
                  "value": to_float(row['Revenue_TW']), "formula": "Revenue_TW"})
    if pd.notna(row.get('Share_Pct')):
        facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric": "share", "period": "TW",
                      "value": to_pct(row['Share_Pct']), "formula": "Share_Pct"})
    if pd.notna(row.get('Rank')):
        facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric": "rank", "period": "TW",
                      "value": to_float(row['Rank']), "formula": "Rank"})

# ---------- BIGGEST WoW MOVERS ----------
wow_valid = df.dropna(subset=['WoW_Pct'])
if not wow_valid.empty:
    best_wow = wow_valid.loc[wow_valid['WoW_Pct'].idxmax()]
    worst_wow = wow_valid.loc[wow_valid['WoW_Pct'].idxmin()]
    facts.append({"entity": best_wow['Entity'], "metric": "revenue", "period": "WoW",
                  "value": to_pct(best_wow['WoW_Pct']),
                  "formula": "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100"})
    if worst_wow['Entity'] != best_wow['Entity']:
        facts.append({"entity": worst_wow['Entity'], "metric": "revenue", "period": "WoW",
                      "value": to_pct(worst_wow['WoW_Pct']),
                      "formula": "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100"})

# ---------- BIGGEST YoY MOVERS ----------
yoy_valid = df.dropna(subset=['YoY_Pct'])
if not yoy_valid.empty:
    best_yoy = yoy_valid.loc[yoy_valid['YoY_Pct'].idxmax()]
    worst_yoy = yoy_valid.loc[yoy_valid['YoY_Pct'].idxmin()]
    facts.append({"entity": best_yoy['Entity'], "metric": "revenue", "period": "YoY",
                  "value": to_pct(best_yoy['YoY_Pct']),
                  "formula": "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100"})
    if worst_yoy['Entity'] != best_yoy['Entity']:
        facts.append({"entity": worst_yoy['Entity'], "metric": "revenue", "period": "YoY",
                      "value": to_pct(worst_yoy['YoY_Pct']),
                      "formula": "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100"})

# ---------- ENTITY WITH MOST UNITS / ORDERS THIS WEEK ----------
units_valid = df.dropna(subset=['Units_TW'])
if not units_valid.empty:
    top_units = units_valid.loc[units_valid['Units_TW'].idxmax()]
    facts.append({"entity": top_units['Entity'], "metric": "units", "period": "TW",
                  "value": to_float(top_units['Units_TW']), "formula": "Units_TW"})

orders_valid = df.dropna(subset=['Orders_TW'])
if not orders_valid.empty:
    top_orders = orders_valid.loc[orders_valid['Orders_TW'].idxmax()]
    facts.append({"entity": top_orders['Entity'], "metric": "orders", "period": "TW",
                  "value": to_float(top_orders['Orders_TW']), "formula": "Orders_TW"})

# ---------- Rank 1 entity details ----------
rank_valid = df.dropna(subset=['Rank'])
if not rank_valid.empty:
    rank1 = rank_valid.loc[rank_valid['Rank'].idxmin()]
    facts.append({"entity": rank1['Entity'], "metric": "rank", "period": "TW",
                  "value": to_float(rank1['Rank']), "formula": "Rank"})

# Trim to 25 facts max
facts = facts[:25]

print(json.dumps(facts))
```
